# The calculation paths (spec 0022, docs/guides/calculation-tests.md): a change to any of these files runs the full
# verification of calculations (`pnpm --filter @ziffr/core test:numbers`) in CI's `numbers` job and in `pnpm ci:local`.
# One extended regular expression per line, matched against a changed file's path; `#` starts a comment.
# Migrations are matched by what they say: one that names observations, series_values or breakdowns counts too
# (.github/scripts/calculation-paths-touched.sh).

# The calculation modules.
^packages/core/src/(numbers|display-periods|formula|compare|format|parse|basis|correlation|snapshot-periods|periods|workflow-rules|alert-rules|number-style|series-lines|attainment-method|units|exact|adding-up|series|forecast|export-values|recipe-functions|recipe-run|analysis-recipe|built-in-recipes|suitability|polar-marks|recipe-methods|mark-figures)\.ts$
^packages/core/src/numbers/
^packages/core/src/takeaways/
^packages/core/src/methods/
^packages/core/src/analysis-recipes/
# The Extensions built into Ziffr and the registry that lists them (spec 0042): their Methods are calculations too.
^extensions/
^packages/core/src/extensions(\.test)?\.ts$
# Where values are stored, read and combined on their way to a widget, a Snapshot, a deck or a program.
^packages/core/src/(submissions|record-value|api-submissions|workspace-data|snapshots|auto-snapshots|deck-content|page-data|api-metrics|api-dashboards|metric-row|types)\.ts$
^apps/web/src/decks/export\.ts$
^apps/web/src/views/(widget-body|metric-chart|design-view|design-plot|design-polar|design-scoreboard|design-progress|design-cumulative)\.tsx$
# The references, the tests that hold the code to them, the Calculation Catalogue, and how they run.
^docs/reference/calculations\.md$
^packages/core/src/test/reference/
^packages/core/src/aggregations[^/]*\.test\.ts$
^packages/core/src/(display-periods|periods|snapshot-periods|compare|changes|writing|exact|adding-up|format|workflow-rules|alert-rules|retention-rules|attainment-method|derived|formula|numbers|analyses|basis|correlation|forecast|export-values|catalogue|recipe-functions|analysis-recipe|suitability)\.test\.ts$
^packages/core/src/methods/[^/]*\.test\.ts$
^packages/core/src/takeaways/[^/]*\.test\.ts$
^packages/core/src/methods/[^/]*\.test\.ts$
^packages/core/(package\.json|vitest\.config\.ts|calculation-modules\.json|stryker\.config\.mjs)$
^\.github/calculation-paths\.txt$
^\.github/scripts/(calculation-paths-touched\.sh|mutation-changed\.sh|mutation-pr\.sh|mutation-summary\.mjs)$
